fields.text: Reading guide page 7 of 10: the host functions behind Genode.log, now, and sleep, the Timer route probe, and the fail-stop (exit 1) on a clock that goes backwards or freezes. The claim to weigh: these effects move bytes or read a clock, Bend decides what and when, and exit 1 is host failure handling. About 15 minutes.
Page 7: all four claims confirmed. Page 8 is posted as q14 (channel sessions and identity), the page where the real GB-006 question sits.
